content.name: Joanne Pritchard
content.title: Higher Level Teaching Assistant (HLTA)
content.summary: HLTA with eight years in Nottingham primary schools, covering classes across KS1 and KS2 and leading phonics and emotional literacy interventions. Since gaining HLTA status I have taught 3 afternoons a week of PPA cover, and my Year 1 phonics groups have reached a 91% pass rate in the screening check.

experience.title: Teaching Assistant
bullets: Supported a Reception class of 30, setting up continuous provision and recording observations for the EYFS profile.
Delivered daily Read Write Inc. phonics to a group of 8 children who had fallen behind.
Led lunchtime games for 60 pupils to reduce playground incidents.

experience.title: Level 3 Teaching Assistant (SEND)
bullets: Supported 2 pupils with EHCPs in Year 4, adapting resources and working towards their outcomes with the SENCo.
Trained as an ELSA and ran weekly emotional literacy sessions for 14 pupils, with fewer behaviour referrals logged for 11 of them.
Prepared home learning packs and phoned 20 vulnerable families weekly during the 2021 lockdown.
Ran Numicon catch-up groups that moved 9 of 12 pupils to age-related expectations in maths.

experience.title: Higher Level Teaching Assistant (HLTA)
bullets: Teach planned lessons to whole classes from Year 1 to Year 6 during PPA time, 3 afternoons a week.
Lead the school's phonics intervention programme; 91% of my Year 1 group passed the phonics screening check in 2025.
Coordinate a team of 6 teaching assistants' intervention timetables and track impact on pupil progress data.
Run a nurture group for 8 pupils at lunch, working closely with the DSL and families.

education.degree: Level 3 Diploma in Specialist Support for Teaching and Learning in Schools
Level 2 Certificate in Supporting Teaching and Learning
GCSEs: 7 at grades A*–C, including English and Maths
